text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need to lock down customer-facing wording and decide who sends the follow-up summaries. I think we should bundle the status page copy with the 72h summary and clarify RCA sharing policy. Who can own these items?

alex: I can take the status page + timeline copy. Proposal:
- statuspage: 1st update within 30m for incident start, 2nd within 2h, then 72h summary
- 72h summary draft owner: sam
- RCA sharing policy draft: jin

sam: ok to own 72h summary. I'll draft a template with sections: impact, mitigation steps, customer action (if any), next steps. Prefer we avoid technical jargon in the customer summary.

jin: I'll draft the policy: recommend 'on-request for affected customers' + public summary on status page once RCA is finalized. Also suggest a consent check before sending any internal logs.

alex: For the status page language, let's avoid 'root cause' until we finalize the RCA. Suggest phrasing: "We experienced an outage affecting [service]; mitigation completed; detailed report forthcoming." Also adding a 'what we did to protect you' bullet helps customers.

maria: Noted. Two operational items I want on the action tracker:
- A1 owner: alex, due: EOD Fri — status page template and immediate copy
- A2 owner: sam, due: 72h after incident — customer-facing summary draft + checklist
- A3 owner: jin, due: next Monday — RCA sharing policy + consent flow
- A4 owner: eng-sre (work with runtime) — investigate recurring Monday morning KV-cache warmup causing 502 spikes, triage build

alex: I'll also add the 'rollback vs fallback' communication blurb to the template.

ops-bot: Incident #20345 closed by alex. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/20345

maria: Let's reconvene next Tue 10am to review drafts. If anyone can't make it, drop comments on the doc. :thumbsup:
